population: The totals count residents, regardless of citizenship.
internet: The share of people who used the internet in the previous three months.
urbanization: Urban residents as a share of the population.
life-expectancy: Expected lifespan at birth, based on each year's mortality rates.
fertility: Births per woman, based on each year's fertility rates.
birth-rate: Live births per 1,000 residents each year.
ageing: Residents aged 65 and over as a share of the population.
young-population: Children aged 0-14 as a share of the population.
working-age: Residents aged 15-64 as a share of the population.
population-density: Residents per square kilometre of land.
urban-population: Total residents living in urban areas.
rural-population: Total residents living in rural areas.
mobile-subscriptions: Total subscriptions, including multiple connections held by the same person.
female-labour: The share of women aged 15+ in the labour force, using ILO estimates.
trade-openness: Imports and exports of goods and services as a share of GDP.
exports: Exports of goods and services in current US dollars.
imports: Imports of goods and services in current US dollars.
gdp-per-person: GDP per resident in current US dollars.
export-share: Exports of goods and services as a share of GDP.
import-share: Imports of goods and services as a share of GDP.
industry: Industrial value added, including construction, in current US dollars.
manufacturing: Manufacturing value added in current US dollars.
health-spending: Current healthcare spending as a share of GDP.
services: Services value added in current US dollars.
remittances: Personal remittances received in current US dollars.
reserves: Official reserves, including gold, in current US dollars.
unemployment: The unemployed share of the labour force, using ILO estimates.
air-travel: Passengers carried by airlines registered in each economy.
electricity-access: The share of residents with electricity access.
clean-cooking: The share of residents mainly using clean cooking fuels and technologies.
renewable-power: Renewables as a share of electricity output, including hydropower.
hydropower: Hydropower as a share of electricity output.
nuclear-power: Nuclear power as a share of electricity output.
energy-intensity: Primary energy use per unit of GDP, adjusted for purchasing power.
forest-area: Total forest area in square kilometres.
agricultural-land: Agricultural land in square kilometres, including permanent pastures.
coal-electricity: Coal as a share of electricity output.
capture-fisheries: Wild fish catches in metric tonnes.
aquaculture: Farmed aquatic production in metric tonnes.
research-spending: Research and development spending as a share of GDP.
labour-force: People aged 15+ who are employed or seeking work.
